summary: A pear-shaped lab-grown diamond framed by a fluid, bezel-inspired setting and an organically curved, tapered band in 14K yellow gold.
description:
Part of our 2026 Unconventional Engagement Ring Collection, this pear-shaped diamond ring is designed for someone looking beyond the traditional solitaire. Polished yellow gold sweeps organically around a pear-shaped lab-grown diamond for a fluid, modern silhouette.

The curved band begins at approximately 2 mm at its widest starting point and gradually tapers toward the centre stone. Crafted in 14K yellow gold, the design balances bold goldwork with the brilliance of the pear-shaped diamond.

Centre diamond size, lab-grown or natural diamond, metal colour and other details can be adjusted on request. Tell us your preferred specifications for a personal quote.
